description: Verify that DUT acks tester FIN and on user CLOSE emits its own FIN to reach CLOSED (RFC 793 §3.5 Closing a Connection)
approach:
[Objective]
The passive-close half: tester FIN first → DUT acks (CLOSE-WAIT) → user CLOSE → DUT FIN (LAST-ACK).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: FIN.
3. DUT → Tester: ACK.
4. Tester (UT) → DUT: CLOSE call.
5. DUT → Tester: FIN.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted ACK to tester FIN + DUT-emitted FIN after CLOSE both observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_ack — no DUT ACK to tester FIN
• Fail_timeout_fin — no DUT FIN after CLOSE

verdicts.Fail_timeout_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN
